en: A black and white image of a European street featuring ornate late 19th-century or early 20th-century buildings with steep, gabled roofs and elaborate stonework. The street is relatively empty, with a few people dressed in period attire, including a woman in a white dress with a parasol. There is a sign on one of the buildings that reads 'Oberrealschule,' indicating an educational institution. The architectural style and street layout suggest a central European city.
